extracted.intended_audience: researchers (all career levels), grant reviewers, and organizations/institutions/funders seeking training in equitable peer review
extracted.subtask_description: Workshops and training materials for teaching equitable, bias-aware manuscript and grant peer review, including practical review exercises, pedagogy for inclusive delivery, and guidance on creating fair evaluation rubrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: General understanding of journal-organized and independent review processes
rubrics_metrics.description: A general understanding of journal-organized and independent review processes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a learning objective for both Open Reviewers and multi-session workshops; frames subsequent training on how review systems work and differ (e.g., journal vs independent/preprint review).

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to how systems of oppression manifest in the manuscript review process
rubrics_metrics.description: An introduction to how systems of oppression manifest in the manuscript review process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented in the 2-hour Open Reviewers workshop as an entry-level objective to raise awareness of structural inequities that influence manuscript evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed understanding of how systems of oppression manifest in the manuscript review process
rubrics_metrics.description: A detailed understanding of how systems of oppression manifest in the manuscript review process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learning objective for multi-session workshops that expands the introductory material into deeper exploration and examples of how bias operates in reviewing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to strategies to self-assess and mitigate bias in manuscript review
rubrics_metrics.description: An introduction to strategies to self-assess and mitigate bias in the context of manuscript review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 2-hour workshop objective emphasizing self-reflection techniques and initial mitigation strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategies to self-assess and mitigate bias in grant review
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies to recognize, self-assess, and address bias in the context of grant review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Core learning objective of the Open Grant Reviewers workshop; tied to training materials including a Bias Reflection Guide and discussion activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to review a manuscript to minimize bias and provide constructive feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: How to review a manuscript in a way that minimizes bias, striving for constructive, clear, and actionable feedback
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasized across multi-session workshops as both an aim and practiced skill; includes producing reviews that are actionable and minimize subjective bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to review a grant to minimize bias and provide constructive feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: How to review a grant in a way that minimizes bias, striving for constructive, clear, and actionable feedback
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open Grant Reviewers objective: practical guidance on structuring grant assessments to reduce subjectivity and improve equity in funding decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-depth practical experience with bias-minimizing peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: An in-depth understanding of and practical experience with peer reviewing a manuscript in a way that minimizes bias, striving for constructive, clear, and actionable feedback
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi-session workshops culminate in a Live Review where participants practice reviewing with attention to bias mitigation and clear, usable feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative review practice and publication of resulting review
rubrics_metrics.description: An opportunity to put learning into practice by collaboratively reviewing a preprint and publishing the resulting preprint review on PREreview.org
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants may jointly select a preprint, perform a Live Review facilitated by PREreview staff, and publish the review—bridging training and public practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advice on creating rubrics and evaluation criteria to reduce subjectivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice around best practices in creating rubrics and evaluation criteria that help reduce subjectivity, and bring greater transparency and equity into the review process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offered in the Open Grant Reviewers curriculum to help reviewers and funders design fairer assessment tools; includes guidance for rubric construction to increase transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Bias Reflection Guide and training materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of training materials which include a Bias Reflection Guide
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials provided to workshop participants support self-reflection and structured mitigation of bias; referenced specifically for grant-review training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshops designed for safe and inclusive delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshops are designed for safe and inclusive delivery - providing clear guidelines ahead of time and by accommodating participants’ different communication and participation styles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizers commit to accessibility and psychological safety in delivery, both online and in-person, including pre-session guidance and accommodations for diverse interaction styles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive, collaborative pedagogies and tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Content is intentionally interactive and is presented to participants using collaborative note-taking and other supporting tools, such as Mentimeter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pedagogical approach favors interactivity and collaborative activities to engage participants and surface multiple perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live Review sessions facilitated by PREreview staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Live Review session facilitated by PREreview staff where participants select and review a preprint together
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical, instructor-led review experience embedded in multi-session workshops to model best practices and mentorship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debate-based learning and open discussions among reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Curriculum includes space for debate-based learning and open discussions among the reviewers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used especially in grant-review workshops to surface differing viewpoints, challenge assumptions, and practice justifying assessments transparently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage and train a pool of diverse, socially conscious grant reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Goal is to engage and train a pool of diverse, socially conscious grant reviewers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic aim to build reviewer diversity and social consciousness as part of improving equity in funding decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equitable pricing and access considerations for workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: An equitable pricing plan for workshops based on organization size/country income, with fee waivers for small/IDA countries
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pricing tiers provided for up to 30 participants with adjustments by organization revenue/country classification; free slots limited and sponsorship options for longer workshops; plan developed with reference to C4DISC, The Carpentries, and Crossref’s GEM program.

rubrics_metrics.name: PREreview Champions: capacity-building for local adoption
rubrics_metrics.description: Equip community members with the resources, skills, and support to facilitate the adaptation and adoption of open and equitable peer-review practices within their local communities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yearly program (piloted 2024) to train facilitators/champions who will propagate equitable reviewing practices; linked to ongoing blog resources and community support (Slack).
